parsed.answer: The corpus supports the claim: an autoimmune disease-associated IL2RA haplotype correlates with diminished IL-2 responsiveness (reduced STAT5a phosphorylation) and diminished CD4+CD25+ Treg suppressive function in healthy human subjects, avoiding disease confounding. Additionally, genetically reduced IL-2 availability correlates with reduced CD4+CD25+ Treg function and autoimmune dysregulation in mice. Both lines link impaired IL-2 signaling in Tregs to autoimmunity, including Type 1 Diabetes.
